u-menus FRONTEND — upload to https://u-menus.com/

This folder is already built. Do not run Flutter or npm on the server.

1. Unzip into public_html (or the document root of u-menus.com).
2. Keep .htaccess in that folder (needed for /admin and /r/...).
3. Open https://u-menus.com/ and https://u-menus.com/admin

This build talks to https://backend.u-menus.com/api
The backend must be running first, or the admin page cannot load data.
